description: A brutalist, typography-driven, high-contrast PLG (Product-Led Growth) tool that acts as a revelatory 'data made visible' moment for founders. It intentionally avoids generic SaaS templates to create an editorial, 'truth-bomb' aesthetic.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use large padding (p-8, p-12, p-24) to frame content like an art gallery. Brutalist grid structures with 1px or 2px solid dark borders. No rounded corners, or max 2px.

surfaces.hero_section: min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-center px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-16

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm px-8 py-4 border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-white hover:text-[#0A0A0A] transition-colors duration-200
buttons.danger_accent: bg-[#FF3333] text-white font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm px-8 py-4 border-2 border-[#FF3333] hover:bg-transparent hover:text-[#FF3333] transition-colors duration-200

risk_badges.high: bg-[#FF3333]/10 text-[#FF3333] border border-[#FF3333]/20 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase
risk_badges.medium: bg-[#FF9500]/10 text-[#FF9500] border border-[#FF9500]/20 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase
risk_badges.low: bg-[#007AFF]/10 text-[#007AFF] border border-[#007AFF]/20 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase

components.table_list: border-y border-[#0A0A0A] divide-y divide-[#0A0A0A]/20. Cells should have generous vertical padding (py-6).

motion.scanning_animation: Use an intense, terminal-like rapid text scrambling or marquee effect. A fast-updating counter and raw JSON-like text flashing on screen (using `framer-motion` or plain React state loops) to simulate the RAG brain reading emails in real-time.
motion.reveal: The number '7' (or X) must fade/scale in massively (e.g., text-[25vw]) with a harsh, heavy impact. No bouncy spring animations. Stiff, authoritative ease-out.

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react (use harsh, geometric icons like X, Terminal, ArrowRight)

image_urls.description: Minimalist architectural tension, black and white walkway. Use as a very subtle background overlay (opacity-10 mixed mode) or in the scanning phase to represent 'paths'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a single-page PLG tool in React/Tailwind. The app runs sequentially through 4 segments.
SEGMENT 1 (Hero): A massive, stark headline about missing conversations. A giant 'Connect Gmail' button. Add trust signals (Read-only, 60 seconds, no signup) underneath in tiny mono font.

SEGMENT 2 (Scanning): When they click 'Connect', switch to a 'Terminal/RAG' simulation view. Black background, green/white monospace text flashing lines of 'parsing inbox', 'vectorizing context', 'evaluating sentiment' for ~5 seconds (mock the 60 seconds to 5 seconds for prototype UX).

SEGMENT 3 (The Reveal): The screen clears. A massive, screen-filling number '7' appears in pure black or stark red (#FF3333). Below it: 'conversations went cold in the last 90 days. Here is who.' Below that, render a sleek, brutalist list/table of the 7 conversations. Columns: Contact (Avatar + Name), Company (Logo + Name), Last Message (Days ago), Reason (AI generated snippet), Risk Tier Badge (High/Med/Low).
SEGMENT 4 (CTA): Below the list, a heavy, dark block section: 'Shram would have caught all 7. Request Access.' Input field for email, and a 'Request Access' submit button.

CRITICAL STYLING: Do NOT use Shadcn's default rounded cards. Everything must be sharp edges (rounded-none), solid borders (border-2 border-black), and raw. DO NOT use Inter. Use Cabinet Grotesk/Clash Display for headings and IBM Plex Mono for all data/tables/buttons.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, the email input, and each row in the conversation table.
